International Alert is active in over 20 countries and territories with a focus on peace building. Alert aims at creating conducive conditions for peacefuld solutions to violent conflict.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: International Alert has worked in several regions around the world to contribute to lasting peace. The regions it has divided its work into are; Africa, Eurasia, Middle East and North Africa Region and South and Southeast Asia. Core achievements relate to working with various groups in conflict affected societies to build confidence and trust, in order to create conditions for lasting peace. International Alert has supported and built the capacity of platforms to resolve and reduce the incidence of conflicts over land and other issues in Rwanda, DRC, Nigeria, the Philippines and Uganda. The organisation has increased awareness of gender issues among various stakeholders, and the participation of women in decision-making and / or justice processes in DRC, South Caucasus, Nepal and Sri Lanka. International Alert has also provided advice on more successful approaches to peace and political negotiations in the Philippines and Abkhazia. It has provided capacity-building support to NGOs, inter-governmental organizations, international businesses and journalists in order to influence them to act and operate with conflict sensitivity.
